securityBaselines.name: Windows Server hardening baseline
securityBaselines.description: CIS-derived hardening standard for all Windows servers, including logging and EDR agent requirements.

securityBaselines.description: Zone model separating investor-facing DMZ, application, database and management networks.

securityFindings.title: Exploitable path from DMZ to RTA interface servers
securityFindings.description: External penetration test demonstrated lateral movement from the web DMZ to RTA interface servers via an unpatched middleware service.
securityFindings.remediationPlan: Middleware patched; segmentation rule review and re-test scheduled.

securityFindings.title: EDR agent missing on 30% of servers
securityFindings.description: EDR coverage audit found agents missing or unhealthy on 28 of 92 servers, concentrated in the legacy fund accounting estate.
securityFindings.remediationPlan: Deployment wave completes with the platform upgrade; interim network monitoring rules added.

securityFindings.title: Shared administrator account on backup console
securityFindings.description: Backup administration console accessed via a shared local admin account without individual attribution.
securityFindings.remediationPlan: Individual named accounts created; shared account disabled after migration.

securityFindings.title: Dependency scan: critical vulnerability in web framework
securityFindings.description: Investor portal build includes a web framework version with a known remote code execution vulnerability.
securityFindings.remediationPlan: Framework upgrade in next portal release; WAF virtual patch applied.

securityFindings.title: USB write access enabled on dealing desk workstation
securityFindings.description: One dealing desk workstation had USB write access enabled contrary to the endpoint baseline.
securityFindings.remediationPlan: Endpoint policy re-applied; compliance scan added to weekly checks.

accessGrants.justificationSummary: Emergency corrective posting during the April NAV recomputation incident.
